change.title: pr-10
change.description: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding
change.author: Robin Ward

findings.title: Migration aborts on any site that never set embed_category
findings.body: The first query selects the category through an INNER JOIN on site_settings where name = 'embed_category'. embed_category defaults to '' (config/site_settings.yml:761-768) and nothing writes a row for it (grep finds no other occurrence in db/). On a default install the query returns zero rows, so [0] is nil and ['id'] raises NoMethodError, and the upgrade stops. The fallback at line 14 (category_id == 0) is never reached because line 11 raises first. Line 15 has the same problem when uncategorized_category_id has no stored row. Fix: check for an empty result before indexing, for both lookups.

findings.title: Migrated hosts are copied unnormalised and never match
findings.body: Each line of the old setting is inserted verbatim. The old lookup stripped http(s):// and paths (removed in this PR from app/models/site_setting.rb; the base spec tested http:// and https:// entries). This migration bypasses before_validation (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8), so https://example.com/1234 is stored as-is. The lookup at app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 compares lower(host) with the bare host, so the row never matches and embedding is refused silently. Fix: strip the scheme and path in Ruby before inserting.

findings.title: Host entries with a port are accepted but can never match
findings.body: The validator (line 2) allows an optional :port, so example.com:8080 saves without error. record_for_host compares against uri.host, which never includes the port, so that row never matches and the admin gets no warning. The lookup also does not downcase its input while the column side is downcased, so an input with uppercase letters never matches. EmbedController and TopicRetriever pass the raw referer or URL. Reject ports in the validator, or compare host and port, and downcase the input.

findings.title: Feed-polled entries lose their category and may fail silently
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import used to take the global embed_category. It now takes the category of the host row matching the URL, or nil (lines 36-43). The feed poller calls import for every entry with no host check (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:37-41), so entries from hosts outside the allow-list get a nil category, which the PR does not mention. With allow_uncategorized_topics off and a non-staff embed user, Topic validation rejects a nil category (app/models/topic.rb:62-71). PostCreator still returns the post object (lib/post_creator.rb:149), so TopicEmbed.create! runs with a nil topic_id, which the schema marks NOT NULL (app/models/topic_embed.rb:170). That either raises and stops the rest of the feed batch, or drops the entry, and nothing reports it. Confirm the PostCreator path, then keep a default category for feed imports or make the failure visible.

findings.title: Update, destroy and save return a 500 when the row or host param is missing
findings.body: update (line 10) and destroy (line 15) call .first with no nil check. If another admin already deleted the row, host.destroy on nil raises and returns a 500 rather than a clean 404. A missing embeddable_host[host] param reaches before_validation (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6), where self.host.sub! raises on nil. Return not-found for a missing row and check that host is present.

findings.title: Delete failures are silent
findings.body: destroyRecord().then(...) has no catch (lines 46-48). If the DELETE fails, the row stays and no error is shown. Save uses .catch(popupAjaxError) (line 40), so delete should match it.

findings.title: Validator rejects some valid hostnames, including on re-save of migrated rows
findings.body: The TLD is limited to [a-z]{2,5}, so hosts with longer TLDs such as .community cannot be added. Migrated rows skip validation, so such a host can be kept but fails validation on the next save. Confirm the intended TLD rule.

findings.title: create_table force: true drops an existing embeddable_hosts table without a check
findings.body: force: true drops any existing embeddable_hosts table and its rows. On a normal upgrade the table does not exist, so nothing is lost. If it does exist, its rows are silently discarded and only rows copied from the old setting remain. Consider create_table without force, or guard with table_exists?.

findings.title: PUT customize/embedding returns success without saving anything
findings.body: update (lines 9-11) re-renders the current state and persists nothing. saveChanges calls it (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7), but embedding.hbs has no button that triggers it. Remove the dead route and action, or implement the update.

findings.title: 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' does not test a blank host
findings.body: The test (lines 1403-1405) builds a topic with no TopicEmbed and sets no host. It passes because has_topic_embed? is false (app/models/topic.rb:864-866), not because of any host check, which was removed from expandable_first_post? (topic.rb:868-870). Rename or delete it. The nested describe at line 1407 has a typo, 'emeddable'.

findings.title: 'find embedded' asks for id 2 but the mock always returns the first fruit
findings.body: store.find('fruit', 2) is called, but the /fruits/:id mock ignores the id and returns fruits[0] (test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:226-229). The colour assertions (lines 114-117) therefore check apple's color_ids [1,2], not banana's [3] that id 2 would return. Make the mock honour the id, or request id 1.

findings.title: The two fabricator files have swapped contents
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb holds the embeddable_host fabricator, and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb holds the category fabricators. The tests still load, but the names mislead. Swap the contents back.

findings.title: Admin controller specs only check inheritance
findings.body: This file and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb:5-7 assert only that the class inherits from Admin::AdminController. Nothing covers create, update, destroy, show, validation errors, or the staff-only access they depend on.

findings.title: _ids hydration throws on a null value and has a dead fallback
findings.body: The new _ids branch calls obj[k].map (line 197). A null or non-array value on any rest-serialised response throws and aborts hydration of that response. The || [] at line 200 can never run because map always returns an array. No current caller hits this, but the branch applies to every rest-serialised response.

contracts.action: Open the Embedding admin page (route model load and list render)
contracts.before_after: Before: no page. After: store.find('embedding') GETs /admin/customize/embedding and hydrates embeddable_hosts from side-loaded records.
contracts.failure_mode: The route does not catch a rejected store.find. The error goes to Ember's default route error handling, which I did not read.
contracts.open_question: What does the page show when the GET fails? The route has no catch.

contracts.action: Add a host and save it (POST)
contracts.before_after: Before: no row. After: addHost pushes an unsaved record; save POSTs /admin/embeddable_hosts, then __state becomes created and the category is set.
contracts.failure_mode: A 422 from save_host (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:27-31) goes to .catch(popupAjaxError) (embeddable-host.js.es6:40). popupAjaxError was not read.
contracts.open_question: Does popupAjaxError show the server's validation message for a 422?

contracts.action: Edit and save an existing host (PUT)
contracts.before_after: Before: stored host. After: PUT /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id; the response's embeddable_host is set on the model and the category is refreshed.
contracts.visible_effect: The category badge updates via host.set('category', ...) (embeddable-host.js.es6:38).
contracts.failure_mode: A 422 goes to popupAjaxError (open, as above). No commitBuffer is called after success (embeddable-host.js.es6:33-40; app/assets/javascripts/discourse/mixins/buffered-content.js.es6:14-16), so re-opening the editor shows the typed text, not the server-normalised host.
contracts.open_question: Is the stale buffer intended, and what does popupAjaxError do on a 422?

contracts.before_after: Before: row present. After: DELETE /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id; the row is removed from the list only after success (admin-embedding.js.es6:14-16).
contracts.visible_effect: The row disappears only on success.
contracts.failure_mode: destroyRecord().then has no catch (embeddable-host.js.es6:46-48), so a failure leaves the row and shows nothing. A missing row returns a 500 (embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:15-16).

contracts.action: Gate public embed requests and topic retrieval by referer or URL host
contracts.equivalent_path: Base commit: SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? (removed from app/models/site_setting.rb in this PR)
contracts.before_after: Before: a non-empty embeddable_hosts setting and an allow-list match. After: EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? only.
contracts.visible_effect: Non-listed referers get the invalid-access page.
contracts.failure_mode: URI errors are rescued in record_for_host (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:11) and in the controller (embed_controller.rb:65-66). Hosts with a port never match (see the finding on embeddable_host.rb:17), so those entries silently refuse embedding.

contracts.action: Import an embedded topic into a category (also reached by the feed poller)
contracts.equivalent_path: Base commit: category: SiteSetting.embed_category (setting removed in config/site_settings.yml)
contracts.before_after: Before: one global embed_category. After: the category of the host row matching the URL, or nil.
contracts.visible_effect: Sets the category of the created topic.
contracts.failure_mode: A nil category for unlisted hosts fails Topic validation for non-staff authors when uncategorized topics are off (app/models/topic.rb:62-71). Whether the resulting error raises or drops the entry is the open point (see the finding on topic_embed.rb:43).
contracts.open_question: Does PostCreator#create return a post with errors when the topic fails validation, so that TopicEmbed.create! runs with a nil topic_id?

contracts.action: Expandable first post for embedded topics
contracts.before_after: Before: required a non-empty embeddable_hosts setting. After: requires only embed_truncate and an existing topic_embed.
contracts.visible_effect: Embedded topics can be expanded even if no hosts are configured.

contracts.before_after: Before: the embeddable_hosts and embed_category settings. After: rows in embeddable_hosts, and those settings deleted.
contracts.visible_effect: None directly. On a default install the upgrade fails (blocker finding).
contracts.failure_mode: Raises NoMethodError on an empty result (line 11), so the upgrade stops.

contracts.action: DELETE of the old site_settings rows (destructive step)
contracts.before_after: Before: rows named embeddable_hosts and embed_category. After: those rows are removed.
contracts.visible_effect: The settings disappear from the admin settings UI.
contracts.failure_mode: 1) The target is picked by name only and not re-checked, but the DELETE runs after the copy in the same method, so an error in the copy stops before it. 2) Nothing is retried. 3) Only the two named rows are removed, and only after the copy succeeded. Whether a later failure rolls this DELETE back depends on Rails' DDL transaction behaviour on PostgreSQL, which I did not read.
contracts.open_question: Does this migration run inside a transaction on the target database, so a failure rolls back the DELETE?

contracts.before_after: Before: an existing embeddable_hosts table would be used. After: any existing table with that name is dropped and recreated.
contracts.failure_mode: The target is not checked. If the table already exists, its rows are discarded.

contracts.before_after: Before: one row. After: that row is deleted.
contracts.visible_effect: The client removes the row only on success.
contracts.failure_mode: The target is found by id alone and not re-checked. A missing row raises and returns a 500. Only one row is removed. No journal is kept, and a failed request leaves the client row in place.

contracts.action: Hydrate *_ids keys on rest-serialised responses (store change)
contracts.before_after: Before: *_ids keys were left as id arrays. After: they become pluralised arrays of hydrated objects, or undefined entries when the root side-load is missing.
contracts.visible_effect: No change for the rest-serialised responses checked: SimilarTopicSerializer uses a has_one (topic_id); queued posts were not checked.
contracts.failure_mode: A null or non-array *_ids value throws at line 197 and aborts hydration of that response. user_serializer.rb:73 uses root: :user_badges, so its side-load key does not match the pluralised name if that serializer is ever rest-serialised.
contracts.open_question: Do the queued-post serializer or any other rest-serialised serializer emit *_ids keys that are not side-loaded?

contracts.action: Map admin type names in the REST adapter's basePath
contracts.equivalent_path: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6:22 (before the change, the exact name was compared)
contracts.before_after: Before: exact match against ADMIN_MODELS. After: underscores are turned into hyphens first.
contracts.visible_effect: None for the current callers I checked.
contracts.failure_mode: A caller that passes an underscored type in ADMIN_MODELS (for example site_customization) now gets the /admin/ base path.
contracts.open_question: Does any caller pass an underscored type that is in ADMIN_MODELS?

contracts.before_after: Before: none. After: the endpoint re-renders the current state and saves nothing.
contracts.visible_effect: None: embedding.hbs has no button that calls it.
contracts.failure_mode: A caller that did reach it would get success for a change that was not saved.

contracts.action: Show the Embedding item in the Customize navigation
contracts.before_after: Before: no item. After: one nav item for adminEmbedding.
contracts.visible_effect: A new nav entry labelled admin.embedding.title.

summary: The migration is blocking: on any install that never set embed_category (the default), the first query indexes an empty result and the upgrade fails. Beyond that, the migration copies legacy host entries without normalising them, so existing http:// or path entries silently stop matching. The host lookup also accepts ports that can never match, and nothing prevents duplicate hosts with different categories. The feed poller now gets a nil category for hosts outside the allow-list (medium confidence; depends on PostCreator's return value). Several smaller items are listed as consider: missing-row 500s, silent delete failures, and tests that do not test what their names say. Caveats: I read the locale files only at the changed hunks, and topic_spec.rb only around the changed block (1390-1450) plus the diff. I did not run anything; findings rest on reading the code.
